subject.title: fix(outbound): keep newline-mode paragraphs as separate outbound units

question: Should the shared outbound planner define `chunkMode: "newline"` as a no-join delivery mode for all channels, even when adjacent paragraphs fit within a channel's transport limit?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow, but it intentionally changes an existing shared configuration behavior from packing short paragraphs to sending them separately across planner-backed channel routes.

options.title: Adopt no-join newline semantics
options.body: Treat blank-line paragraphs as visible delivery boundaries throughout the shared planner and merge this implementation after the normal head refresh and checks.

options.title: Scope the behavior to a narrower runtime boundary
options.body: Preserve existing shared planner packing and carry Codex reply-block boundaries through a runtime-specific representation if cross-channel newline behavior should remain unchanged.

recommendation.title: Adopt no-join newline semantics
recommendation.body: Treat blank-line paragraphs as visible delivery boundaries throughout the shared planner and merge this implementation after the normal head refresh and checks.
